list.text: Welcome to Goldenrod's Radio Tower!
Welcome to Goldenrod's Radio Tower!

then.text: \rWelcome to Goldenrod's Radio Tower!
\r...Or, maybe not.\nI am sorry to tell you this, but no one can visit the tower now.

list.text: \rThis is the Pokémon Lottery Corner. I'm Felicity, your attendant today.
\rIf the drawn number matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon, you could win fabulous gifts.
\rWould you like to check today's lucky number?

branches.text: \rFirst, I'll look up today's Pokémon Lottery Corner lucky number.
\rYour Loto Ticket number is \v[1].
\rNow, let's see if it matches the ID No. of any of your Pokémon.

then.text: \rI'm sorry. You didn't get a match...
\rPlease do visit again.
\rCongratulations!
\rThe ID number of your team's \v[2] matches your Loto Ticket number!

else.text: \rThe ID number of your PC-boxed \v[2] matches your Loto Ticket number!

then.text: \rOh my goodness, all five digits matched!
\rYou've won the jackpot prize!
\rPlease do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

then.text: \rThe last four digits matched, so you win the first prize!
\rPlease do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

then.text: \rThe last three digits matched, so you win the second prize!
\rPlease do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

then.text: \rThe last two digits matched, so you win the third prize!
\rPlease do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

then.text: \rThe last digit matched, so you win the fourth prize!
\rPlease do visit again! Good-bye from Felicity, your attendant!

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

branches.text: \rOh, I see.\nPlease do visit us again.

list.text: \rYou've already drawn a Loto Ticket today. Please come back tomorrow.
\rI've been waiting for you. Here's the item you won.

else.text: \rYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.

list.text: We have a special Quiz campaign!
Answer five question correctly in a row to win a Radio Card!
When you load it into the Pokégear, you will be able to listen to the radio...anytime, anywhere!
Would you like to try our Quiz?

branches.text: The first question!
Can you check the Town Map with your Pokégear?
You are correct.\nThe second question!
Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\nPlease try again!
NIDORINA can only be female.\nTrue?
You are correct.\nThe third question!
Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\nPlease try again!
Kurt, the Poké Ball creator, uses apricots as ingredients?
Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\nPlease try again!
You are correct.\nThe fourth question!
It's impossible to use a TM on MAGIKARP. True?
Wow!\nI have only one more question to go.
Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\nPlease try again!
In Professor Oak's popular show, Pokémon Talk, is he on with Marie?
Oh, dear.\nSorry, but you got it wrong.\nPlease try again!
Bingo! You got it!\nCongratulations!\nHere's your prize, a Radio Card!
\PN can now listen to the radio with the Pokégear!

\f[whitney]\c[5]Oops!\nIt's time to go back at the Gym!
Oh. I see.\nPlease see me if you change your mind.

then.text: You think you're strong now that you look like us?
That's foolish!\nYou shouldn't wear it!

list.text: You are too powerful.
You could spoil our plan.\nI have to inform the others...

then.text: Ha! You must be new!\nYou look pretty good in the Team Rocket uniform!
Go on ahead!

else.text: Who are you?\nWe have some business going on.
I was told not to let anyone pass but Team Rocket!
You are only allowed to come through when you are wearing the cool black uniform for Team Rocket!

list.text: \f[whitney]\c[5]Hi!\nMy name is Whitney!
\f[whitney]\c[5]I heard about the Quiz to win a Radio Card, so I came here to get one...
